content.json:
# CAMS People Usage

One row per person who signed in to CAMS during the chosen time range, with the roles, offices, and regions they held when they signed in. A person is identified by work email; names are not recorded.

**This workbook shows work email addresses.** Access is limited to team members the product owner has approved for read access to the API's Application Insights. Dates are UTC. See *People Usage List* in the CAMS operations docs.

parameters.name: CoverageNote

content.query:
let roleLabels = datatable(role: string, label: string) [
    "SuperUser", "Super User",
    "PrivilegedIdentityUser", "Privileged Identity Management",
    "CaseAssignmentManager", "Case Assignment Manager",
    "TrialAttorney", "Trial Attorney",
    "LeadTrialAttorney", "Lead Trial Attorney",
    "DataVerifier", "Data Verifier",
    "TrusteeAdmin", "Trustee Admin",
    "Auditor", "Auditor",
    "Paralegal", "Paralegal"
];
let signIns = customEvents
    | where timestamp {TimeRange}
    | where name == "CAMS Sign-In"
    | extend Email = tostring(customDimensions.email)
    | extend Email = iff(isempty(Email), "(no email recorded)", Email);
let lastUsed = signIns
    | summarize LastUsed = max(timestamp) by Email;
let roles = signIns
    | mv-expand role = parse_json(tostring(customDimensions.roles)) to typeof(string)
    | where isnotempty(role)
    | lookup kind=leftouter roleLabels on role
    | summarize RoleSet = make_set(coalesce(label, role)) by Email
    | project Email, Roles = strcat_array(array_sort_asc(RoleSet), ", ");
let offices = signIns
    | mv-expand officeName = parse_json(tostring(customDimensions.officeNames)) to typeof(string)
    | where isnotempty(officeName)
    | summarize OfficeSet = make_set(officeName) by Email
    | project Email, Offices = strcat_array(array_sort_asc(OfficeSet), ", ");
let regions = signIns
    | extend regionIds = parse_json(tostring(customDimensions.regionIds)), regionNames = parse_json(tostring(customDimensions.regionNames))
    | mv-expand regionId = regionIds to typeof(string), regionName = regionNames to typeof(string)
    | where isnotempty(regionId)
    | distinct Email, regionId, regionName
    | extend RegionLabel = iff(isempty(regionName), strcat("Region ", regionId), strcat("Region ", regionId, " (", regionName, ")"))
    | summarize RegionList = make_list(bag_pack("n", toint(regionId), "label", RegionLabel)) by Email
    | mv-apply r = RegionList on (
        order by toint(r.n) asc
        | summarize Regions = strcat_array(make_list(tostring(r.label)), ", ")
    )
    | project Email, Regions;
lastUsed
| lookup kind=leftouter roles on Email
| lookup kind=leftouter offices on Email
| lookup kind=leftouter regions on Email
| project Email, Roles, Offices, Regions, ['Last Used'] = format_datetime(LastUsed, "yyyy-MM-dd")
| order by Email asc
content.title: People who signed in
content.noDataMessage: No one signed in during the chosen time range.
